data.gender_notes: Appalanaidu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Appalanaidu is a name derived from the Tamil language which translates to 'Lord of Abundance'. This name is associated with strength, power, and wisdom, making it an ideal choice for parents looking for a meaningful name for their child. The name Appalanaidu carries the meaning “Lord of Abundance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Telugu, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Appalanaidu usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Appalanaidu is a revered name in Hinduism, symbolizing the abundance and power of the divine. It is believed to bestow strength, wisdom, and prosperity upon the bearer.
data.etymology: Appalanaidu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Abundance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Appalanaidu total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
